related.title: Random123：計數器式亂數與分解不變性
related.titleEn: Random123: counter-based RNG and decomposition invariance
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付兩種歸約樹、精確參考與可重現性契約；精確1/2參考成立，浮點實驗另記型別、順序與誤差，不混稱精確；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver reduction trees, exact references, and the reproducibility contract. Exact references 1 and 2 must match. Record type, order, and error separately for floating-point experiments. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 列樣本身份=(實驗key,全域索引,分量)，不可把rank作唯一seed後以為重分解仍相同；317兩次一致，全部樣本身份唯一且key未變；亂數本身由正式實作產生。
related.differenceEn: Define identity as experiment key, global index, and component. Rank-only seeds do not preserve samples after repartitioning. Both index calculations give 317. All sample identities must be unique and use the fixed key; actual draws come from the established implementation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 真實數加法可結合，但有限精度每次加法會捨入；測試應保留輸入順序與精確參考；合成十進位整數[10^16,1,−10^16]，精確總和1；變更中間值2後精確總和2；名義式 (10**16-10**16)+1 = 1 exact integer reference sum；變更式 (10**16-10**16)+2 = 2 exact integer reference sum。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
rank r各持m個樣本時全域索引i=r×m+j；不重複的索引配合固定key可跨工作分解追蹤樣本；合成r3、m100、j17；改m50並用r6、j17表示同一全域樣本；名義式 3*100+17 = 317 global sample index；變更式 6*50+17 = 317 global sample index。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Real addition is associative, but finite-precision operations round each step. Retain input order and an independent exact reference. Synthetic integers [10^16, 1, −10^16] sum exactly to 1. Changing the middle value to 2 gives an exact sum of 2. Nominal (10**16-10**16)+1 = 1 exact integer reference sum; changed (10**16-10**16)+2 = 2 exact integer reference sum. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

With m samples per rank, global index i = r m + j. Unique indices with a fixed key preserve sample identity across decompositions. Synthetic r = 3, m = 100, j = 17; compare r = 6, m = 50, j = 17 for the same global sample. Nominal 3*100+17 = 317 global sample index; changed 6*50+17 = 317 global sample index. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Amdahl：串行比例與投資上限
related.titleEn: Amdahl: serial fractions and optimization limits
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付兩種歸約樹、精確參考與可重現性契約；精確1/2參考成立，浮點實驗另記型別、順序與誤差，不混稱精確；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver reduction trees, exact references, and the reproducibility contract. Exact references 1 and 2 must match. Record type, order, and error separately for floating-point experiments. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 將單核心時間切成串行和平行兩色，註記只縮短平行部分的推導；6.4/9.142857正確，s與P來源明確且沒有宣稱實際速度保證。
related.differenceEn: Split single-core time into serial and parallel parts, then derive the reduction of only the parallel part. Verify both speedups with documented s and P. The ideal model does not guarantee measured speed.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 真實數加法可結合，但有限精度每次加法會捨入；測試應保留輸入順序與精確參考；合成十進位整數[10^16,1,−10^16]，精確總和1；變更中間值2後精確總和2；名義式 (10**16-10**16)+1 = 1 exact integer reference sum；變更式 (10**16-10**16)+2 = 2 exact integer reference sum。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
S(P)=1/[s+(1−s)/P]，忽略新增平行成本；s必須是基準時間比例；合成s=.1，P16；改s=.05仍P16，是額外串行優化的情境；名義式 1/(.1+.9/16) = 6.4 ideal speedup；變更式 1/(.05+.95/16) = 9.14285714286 ideal speedup。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Real addition is associative, but finite-precision operations round each step. Retain input order and an independent exact reference. Synthetic integers [10^16, 1, −10^16] sum exactly to 1. Changing the middle value to 2 gives an exact sum of 2. Nominal (10**16-10**16)+1 = 1 exact integer reference sum; changed (10**16-10**16)+2 = 2 exact integer reference sum. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

S(P) = 1/[s + (1−s)/P], ignoring newly introduced parallel overhead. The fraction s refers to the serial baseline. Synthetic s = 0.1 with P = 16; compare s = 0.05 at the same P as a separate serial optimization. Nominal 1/(.1+.9/16) = 6.4 ideal speedup; changed 1/(.05+.95/16) = 9.14285714286 ideal speedup. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
